## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: weak overall breadth (4/11) plus concentrated leadership in Technology (top performers dominated by Tech), and major divergences across large names (TSLA, XOM, PYPL) — warrant caution and selective positioning.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND. Communication Services next: META (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +3.88%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing pockets of strength: CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Discretionary lagging: TSLA (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare weak: LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY. Industrials soft: BA (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +17.60%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) and style leaning Growth/Momentum but with caution due to narrow concentration.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, ETN (1W: -3.92% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND, ROST (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -9.51%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION — Weakness concentrated in Consumer Discretionary and pockets of Energy/Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: CRM (1W: +22.39%), NOW (1W: +12.63%), MSFT (1W: +6.27%), SLB (1W: +6.42%), ADBE (1W: +5.89%) — watch major divergences: PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND and TSLA CORRECTION signal tactical risk despite some 1M gains.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed but leading on momentum: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: +3.35% | 1M: -4.04%) RECOVERY. Technology strength is concentrated; monitor for breadth deterioration within the sector as market-wide breadth is weak.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials generally steady but uneven: CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +4.38%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND — favor selective financial names showing consistent 1W/1M confirmation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare under pressure and mixed signals: LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +5.29%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY — sector part of the weakness cohort; watch headline-driven moves for tactical entries.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to confirmed leaders (CRM, MSFT, CME) while reducing exposure to pronounced laggards (PYPL, RCL, AMAT); style: Growth/Momentum concentration but tread carefully given narrow leadership and weak breadth. Monitor divergences (TSLA, XOM, PYPL) — treat moves as tactical opportunities rather than broad allocation shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (one of 4 sectors positive; concentrated leadership) and Financials (select names ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare (both showing sector-level weakness and multiple names BELOW TREND or CORRECTION).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Monitor sustainment of 1W gains in CRM/NOW to confirm momentum continuation; watch MSFT for follow-through above recent highs to validate sector leadership; a renewed break below recent 1W lows in PYPL or RCL would signal extended downside and broader risk-off within laggards.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (+65): BA (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines on a large defense order but price is below trend, a divergence to monitor for distribution vs. accumulation. (Only BA from top bullish list appears in detailed dataset with dual timeframes.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (-50): PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND — negative M&A/competitive headlines and price confirming weakness. XOM (-45): XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION — regulatory/fine headlines with price sliding this week, watch for follow-through. COF/GM items flagged negative in news; where confirmed in portfolios, monitor for contagion into credit-sensitive names.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with Growth/Momentum tilt due to concentrated Tech leadership and weak breadth (4/11 sectors positive). CRM, NOW, MSFT ABOVE TREND and showing the strongest momentum. Key risk is major divergence across large caps (PYPL, TSLA, XOM) and bullish headlines on BA while price remains below trend — monitor for confirmation before expanding exposure.
